items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Hammond had just given him an organ. In fact, Hammond built a three manual organ for him in his house

ctx.x: But he had this new, I think it was a new B-3 organ that Hammond -- and he told me to come back stage, and, you know, I went up to his room; you know, Fats always kept wine up there. He never would give you a drink out of his bottle.
He drank gin, wasn't it? Wasn't he a gin --
